<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">What is this repository?</h2><a id="user-content-what-is-this-repository" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: What is this repository?" href="#what-is-this-repository"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">This repository contains the entire orchestration platform to build voice AI applications. It technically orchestrates voice conversations using combination of different ASR+LLM+TTS providers and models over websockets.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Components</h2><a id="user-content-components" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Components" href="#components"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Bolna helps you create AI Voice Agents which can be instructed to do tasks beginning with:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Orchestration platform (this open source repository)</li>
<li>Hosted APIs (<a href="https://docs.bolna.ai/api-reference/introduction" rel="nofollow">https://docs.bolna.ai/api-reference/introduction</a>) built on top of this orchestration platform [currently closed source]</li>
<li>No-code UI playground at <a href="https://platform.bolna.ai/" rel="nofollow">https://platform.bolna.ai/</a> using the hosted APIs + tailwind CSS [currently closed source]</li>
</ol>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Supported providers and models</h2><a id="user-content-supported-providers-and-models" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Supported providers and models" href="#supported-providers-and-models"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Initiating a phone call using telephony providers like <code>Twilio</code>, <code>Plivo</code>, <code>Exotel</code> (coming soon), <code>Vonage</code> (coming soon) etc.</li>
<li>Transcribing the conversations using <code>Deepgram</code>, <code>Azure</code> etc.</li>
<li>Using LLMs like <code>OpenAI</code>, <code>DeepSeek</code>, <code>Llama</code>, <code>Cohere</code>, <code>Mistral</code>,  etc to handle conversations</li>
<li>Synthesizing LLM responses back to telephony using <code>AWS Polly</code>, <code>ElevenLabs</code>, <code>Deepgram</code>, <code>OpenAI</code>, <code>Azure</code>, <code>Cartesia</code>, <code>Smallest</code>, <code>Maya</code>, <code>Kalpa</code> etc.</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">Refer to the <a href="https://docs.bolna.ai/providers" rel="nofollow">docs</a> for a deepdive into all supported providers.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Local example setup [will be moved to a different repository]</h2><a id="user-content-local-example-setup-will-be-moved-to-a-different-repository" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Local example setup [will be moved to a different repository]" href="#local-example-setup-will-be-moved-to-a-different-repository"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">A basic local setup includes usage of <a href="/bolna-ai/bolna/blob/master/local_setup/telephony_server/twilio_api_server.py">Twilio</a> or <a href="/bolna-ai/bolna/blob/master/local_setup/telephony_server/plivo_api_server.py">Plivo</a> for telephony. We have dockerized the setup in <code>local_setup/</code>. One will need to populate an environment <code>.env</code> file from <code>.env.sample</code>.</p>
<p dir="auto">The setup consists of four containers:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Telephony web server:
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Choosing Twilio: for initiating the calls one will need to set up a <a href="https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/tutorials/how-to-use-your-free-trial-account" rel="nofollow">Twilio account</a></li>
<li>Choosing Plivo: for initiating the calls one will need to set up a <a href="https://www.plivo.com/" rel="nofollow">Plivo account</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Bolna server: for creating and handling agents</li>
<li><code>ngrok</code>: for tunneling. One will need to add the <code>authtoken</code> to <code>ngrok-config.yml</code></li>
<li><code>redis</code>: for persisting agents & prompt data</li>
</ol>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Quick Start</h3><a id="user-content-quick-start" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Quick Start" href="#quick-start"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The easiest way to get started is to use the provided script:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="cd local_setup
chmod +x start.sh
./start.sh"><pre><span class="pl-c1">cd</span> local_setup
chmod +x start.sh
./start.sh</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">This script will check for Docker dependencies, build all services with BuildKit enabled, and start them in detached mode.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Manual Setup</h3><a id="user-content-manual-setup" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Manual Setup" href="#manual-setup"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Alternatively, you can manually build and run the services:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Make sure you have Docker with Docker Compose V2 installed</li>
<li>Enable BuildKit for faster builds:
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="export DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1
export COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=1"><pre><span class="pl-k">export</span> DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1
<span class="pl-k">export</span> COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=1</pre></div>
</li>
<li>Build the images:
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker compose build"><pre>docker compose build</pre></div>
</li>
<li>Run the services:
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker compose up -d"><pre>docker compose up -d</pre></div>
</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">To run specific services only:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker compose up -d bolna-app twilio-app
# or
docker compose up -d bolna-app plivo-app"><pre>docker compose up -d bolna-app twilio-app
<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> or</span>
docker compose up -d bolna-app plivo-app</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Once the docker containers are up, you can now start to create your agents and instruct them to initiate calls.</p>

<p dir="auto">You can also build and run an agent directly in Python without the local telephony setup.</p>
<p dir="auto">Example script: <code>examples/simple_assistant.py</code></p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="import asyncio
from bolna.assistant import Assistant
from bolna.models import (
    Transcriber,
    Synthesizer,
    ElevenLabsConfig,
    LlmAgent,
    SimpleLlmAgent,
)


async def main():
    assistant = Assistant(name="demo_agent")

    # Configure audio input (ASR)
    transcriber = Transcriber(provider="deepgram", model="nova-2", stream=True, language="en")

    # Configure LLM
    llm_agent = LlmAgent(
        agent_type="simple_llm_agent",
        agent_flow_type="streaming",
        llm_config=SimpleLlmAgent(
            provider="openai",
            model="gpt-4o-mini",
            temperature=0.3,
        ),
    )

    # Configure audio output (TTS)
    synthesizer = Synthesizer(
        provider="elevenlabs",
        provider_config=ElevenLabsConfig(voice="George", voice_id="JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb", model="eleven_turbo_v2_5"),
        stream=True,
        audio_format="wav",
    )

    # Build a single coherent pipeline: transcriber -> llm -> synthesizer
    assistant.add_task(
        task_type="conversation",
        llm_agent=llm_agent,
        transcriber=transcriber,
        synthesizer=synthesizer,
        enable_textual_input=False,
    )

    # Stream results
    async for chunk in assistant.execute():
        print(chunk)

<p dir="auto">This demonstrates orchestration and streaming output. For telephony, use the services in <code>local_setup/</code>.</p>
<p dir="auto">Note: For REST-based usage (Agent CRUD over HTTP), see <code>API.md</code> in the repo root.</p>
<p dir="auto">Expected output shape: <code>assistant.execute()</code> is an async generator yielding per-task result dicts (event-like chunks). The exact keys depend on configured tools/providers; treat it as a stream and process incrementally.</p>

        print(chunk)

<p dir="auto">For LLMs hosted via VLLM, add the following to the <code>.env</code> file:<br>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Open-source v/s Hosted APIs</h2><a id="user-content-open-source-vs-hosted-apis" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Open-source v/s Hosted APIs" href="#open-source-vs-hosted-apis"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>We have in the past tried to maintain both the open source and the hosted solution (via APIs and a UI dashboard)</strong>.</p>
<p dir="auto">We have fluctuated b/w maintaining this repository purely from a point of time crunch and not interest.</p>
<p dir="auto">Currently, we are continuing to maintain it for the community and improving the adoption of Voice AI.</p>
<p dir="auto">Though the repository is completely open source, you can connect with us if interested in managed hosted offerings or more customized solutions.
<a href="https://calendly.com/bolna/30min" rel="nofollow"><img alt="Schedule a meeting" src="https://camo.githubusercontent." data-canonical-src="https://cdn.cookielaw.org/logos/122ecfc3-4694-42f1-863f-2db42d1b1e68/0bcbbcf4-9b83-4684-ba59-bc913c0d5905/c21bea90-f4f1-43d1-8118-8938bbb27a9d/logo.png" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Extending with other Telephony Providers</h2><a id="user-content-extending-with-other-telephony-providers" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Extending with other Telephony Providers" href="#extending-with-other-telephony-providers"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">In case you wish to extend and add some other Telephony like Vonage, Telnyx, etc. following the guidelines below:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Make sure bi-directional streaming is supported by the Telephony provider</li>
<li>Add the telephony-specific input handler file in <a href="https://github.com/bolna-ai/bolna/tree/master/bolna/input_handlers/telephony_providers">input_handlers/telephony_providers</a> writing custom functions extending from the <a href="https://github.com/bolna-ai/bolna/blob/master/bolna/input_handlers/telephony.py">telephony.py</a> class
<ol dir="auto">
<li>This file will mainly contain how different types of event packets are being ingested from the telephony provider</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>Add telephony-specific output handler file in <a href="https://github.com/bolna-ai/bolna/tree/master/bolna/output_handlers/telephony_providers">output_handlers/telephony_providers</a> writing custom functions extending from the <a href="https://github.com/bolna-ai/bolna/blob/master/bolna/output_handlers/telephony.py">telephony.py</a> class
<ol dir="auto">
<li>This mainly concerns converting audio from the synthesizer class to a supported audio format and streaming it over the websocket provided by the telephony provider</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>Lastly, you'll have to write a dedicated server like the example <a href="https://github.com/bolna-ai/bolna/blob/master/local_setup/telephony_server/twilio_api_server.py">twilio_api_server.py</a> provided in <a href="https://github.com/bolna-ai/bolna/blob/master/local_setup/telephony_server">local_setup</a> to initiate calls over websockets.</li>
</ol>
